AMENDMENT (pre-grill, from the adversarial review of the idea set). Five changes:
(1) THE BRIDGE CANNOT REACH THE DRAFTS THAT EXIST. .agents/gate-obligation/09-leg.json + 09-task-01.json are two complete, well-formed drafted contracts (mtime 2026-09-10, git-tracked) and NO node in the live journey references them — material that has rotted for 7 days, which is this task's own diagnosis. But AC-2's idea! promote only promotes from .ann/ideas/, so it cannot reach them. AMEND: the gesture family admits an existing draft (idea! adopt <path>, or promote <path>), so material that already exists enters the life cycle instead of being hand-copied into spawn!.
(2) THE HOME IS UNSPECIFIED PAPERWORK. .ann/ideas/ is a NEW top-level store area: it appears in neither architecture.md's .ann/ tree (journey/ · docs/ · rules/) nor resource-registry §4's class list / §6 data-code line; and AC-4's 'configured age' needs a §8a-admitted config key (flow.* / preferences.* / server.* only today). AMEND: the task carries those doc amendments as deliverables (docs are git content), naming the key (ideas.staleDays).
(3) ANN_STORE BREAKS THE WRITE. JOURNEY_REFUSED_WRITES (src/surface/handlers.ts:1333) and assertWritable (src/store/store.ts:383) are keyed on journey addressing: under ANN_STORE=<archive> the reads address the archive while idea! add would write the ACTIVE project's ideas. AMEND: name the cross-folder write exception explicitly (AGENTS.md: any writer that must write outside the addressed node is named before it exists) or make the area read-only under a non-active store.
(4) THE PROMOTED LINK DANGLES BY CONSTRUCTION. goal! archive moves only .ann/journey; AC-1 puts ideas at project level outside it; AC-3 forbids the journey naming the idea back AND forbids deriving the idea's status from the journey — so after the first archive every promoted idea points at a node id that no longer exists and nothing can detect it. AMEND: specify it (the link records the SESSION and is never resolved, or the ideas area archives with the session).
(5) NO BOUND. A committed, never-deletable, growing area has no ceiling in AC-4. AMEND: state that list/read stay bounded and that drop is the only exit (human-only), so the area cannot grow unread or unbounded.

claims.statement: The area is .ann/ideas/, one committed file per idea, project-level and outside the journey. THE HARD RULE is proven dynamically: the e2e writes a MALFORMED ideas file (unparseable JSON + a non-idea record) and asserts check, verify, next, advance!, status, packet, confirm, journey and brief are BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after (code, stdout and stderr compared).

The gesture family is read+write split by the marker rule: ann idea list [--all|--stale] is the read; idea! add|promote|drop are the writes. Proven per gesture, with the named failures each leaving ZERO writes: an empty text, an unknown id, a non-id (including ../../etc/passwd, which cannot resolve — an idea id is a filename and only the id shape resolves), a bad gesture and a stray flag.

The bridge is recorded ONCE, on the idea: promote sets status=promoted and promotedTo=<node id>, and the drafted contract intent names the idea id. The node never names the idea back — asserted by git-grepping the whole .ann/journey tree for the id (no match) and by the node list being unchanged by promote. A second promote and a drop of a promoted idea both refuse by name.
idea list --stale names every unpromoted idea older than IDEA_STALE_DAYS (14) and nothing deletes it: the test asserts the file is still on disk after the read, and the read is the only action taken.

No regression: 989 tests pass across 50 files, typecheck is clean, ann check reports no gate gaps and ann verify is clean (0 drifts) on the live journey. The checks are ENGINE-CAPTURED (source=captured, exit code and sha recorded by the engine, not reported). The area is TRACKED and the engine commits its own writes to it: the commit step now takes an explicit list of in-scope trees (engineWriteDirs) instead of one hard-coded journey dir, and a source file edited alongside an idea write stays out of scope by the same filter.
